description: Source code for managing Linux capabilities and process privileges, including functions for dropping and gaining root privileges, handling capabilities, and checking blocklist status.

methods.name: get_process_name
methods.description: Retrieves the process name given a process ID by reading /proc/<pid>/comm.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if a string is NULL or empty.

methods.name: fetchRFC
methods.description: Fetches RFC parameter data for a given key.

methods.name: isBlocklisted
methods.description: Checks if the current process is listed in the blocklist, indicating whether it runs as root.

methods.name: prepare_caps
methods.description: Prepares and sets capabilities for a process, including add/drop lists and user name.

methods.name: init_capability
methods.description: Initializes the capability structure for the current process.

methods.name: read_capability
methods.description: Reads and logs the current capabilities of the process.

methods.name: set_ambient_caps
methods.description: Sets ambient capabilities for the process.

methods.name: drop_root_caps
methods.description: Drops root privileges and capabilities, switching to a non-root user.

methods.name: update_process_caps
methods.description: Updates the process's capabilities based on application settings.

methods.name: drop_root_priv
methods.description: Drops root privileges and capabilities, returning true if successful.

methods.name: gain_root_privilege
methods.description: Gains root privileges by setting UID and GID to 0.
